assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: atmospheric DAYTIME background for an elegant website about thoughtful work, combining natural daylight with a restrained East Asian ink-wash garden mood. Landscape 1536x1024. Camera looking up into a vast empty luminous pale blue-grey morning sky, gently warming to ivory mist toward the bottom. Soft natural aerial perspective, subtle photographic daylight, muted colors, no visible sun (it will be a separate moving element), no stars, no clouds (separate moving layer), no mountains, horizon, buildings, text or interface. Just a FEW SMALL persimmon leaves and one slender twig with one muted amber fruit entering from the extreme bottom-right edge. All botanical details are confined to the BOTTOM 18% of the canvas and RIGHT 25%, thin and delicate, not large or close to the camera. The rest is spacious empty sky; especially the central 70% must remain completely clear for typography. Botanical realism with faint ink-wash softness, sage and grey-green leaves, natural subtle backlit leaf veins, no plastic or paper cutout look. Top sky approximately #dce7ed, fading to warm near-white #f8f5ef at the bottom. No hard vignette and no black outlines.

Generate a transparent background PNG. Use case: photorealistic-natural. A single distant SUN seen through very thin morning atmospheric haze, isolated for compositing into a pale blue daytime sky. Square canvas. Small near-white luminous solar disc centered at 50% x 50%, diameter 40% of canvas, softly overexposed ivory center with barely warm edges. Extremely soft translucent pale warm-white radiance around it fading completely to real alpha before reaching the canvas edges. Natural photographic daylight, not an astronomical surface closeup, no surface texture, no orange outline, no yellow button, no rays, no lens flare streaks, no stars, no clouds, no scene, no checkerboard, no text. Surrounding pixels genuinely transparent. Quiet realistic sunlight that suits an airy muted ink-wash garden.

rendering: Original generated PNG files retained with their alpha. Lunar keyframes are selected by approximate calendar phase; waning phases mirror the corresponding waxing art. No runtime phase clipping or bitmap post-processing. Background artwork is capped at 1280px, centered and faded at the edges.
